headline: Starbucks Jumps After Strong Third-Quarter Results and Higher Full-Year Outlook
summary: Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) reported third-quarter results that comfortably exceeded Wall Street expectations, supported by stronger customer traffic in North America and continued progress under its turnaround strategy. The coffee chain also raised its financial outlook for the full fiscal year.
